title: Greer warns Joe Firmage at Mars Cafe

tellings.quote: bait. He was wealthy. And I met with him at the Mars Cafe in South of Market in San Francisco way back in the 90s.

plain: Steven Greer, a longtime campaigner for UFO disclosure, told the podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that in the 1990s he met Joe Firmage, a wealthy man, at the Mars Cafe in San Francisco's South of Market area. Greer says he warned him that his wealth made him 'bait' for people trying to steer the UFO subject.
